translations.web: You ask, and don’t receive, because you ask with wrong motives, so that you may spend it on your pleasures.
translations.bsb: And when you do ask, you do not receive, because you ask with wrong motives, that you may squander it on your pleasures.
translations.kjv: Ye ask, and receive not, because ye ask amiss, that ye may consume it upon your lusts.
translations.asv: Ye ask, and receive not, because ye ask amiss, that ye may spend it in your pleasures.
